name: US Military and Diplomatic Addresses
description: APO, FPO and DPO addresses with the AA, AE and AP state codes. The delivery line (PSC, CMR, UNIT, ship) is reported in military, as written. Shapes follow USPS Publication 28 (a US government work, public domain); inputs are constructed for this corpus unless a case's source says otherwise.
